security_hardening_standards.rule: Never use MySQL root for application connection. Apply Principle of Least Privilege (PoLP): provision dedicated application user with DML (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE) and migration DDL (CREATE, ALTER, INDEX, REFERENCES) on ${DB_NAME} only, without administrative privileges (SUPER, PROCESS, FILE, SHUTDOWN) or GRANT OPTION.
Accounts restricted to 127.0.0.1 or localhost (no wildcard % hosts). Zero anonymous user accounts.
The application must strictly connect only to ${DB_NAME}. Cross-database fallbacks or accessing other schemas are strictly prohibited; fail fast on startup if schema is unavailable.
Enforce local_infile = OFF to prevent arbitrary file read exploits. Remove test databases.
100% prepared statements or parameterized queries (?) to eliminate SQL Injection (SQLi) risks. String interpolation in SQL is strictly forbidden.
Database server binds to localhost 127.0.0.1 or unix socket only; no exposed public interfaces without TLS encryption and firewall whitelisting.
Database credentials stored exclusively in .env (enforced via .gitignore). Only sanitized dummy placeholders permitted in .env.example.
Backup files in backups/ restricted with strict filesystem permissions (0700 dir, 0600 files).

api_guards.rule: Backend validates roles per route; configuration and user mutations require ADMIN role

secrets_and_env_policy.rule: NEVER embed fallback passwords in source code (e.g. process.env.ADMIN_PASSWORD || 'default'). If a secret is missing from environment, return a 500 configuration error or fail fast on boot.
NEVER include actual passwords, operational credentials or recognizable default passwords in .env.example. Use explicit dummy placeholders like ADMIN_PASSWORD=change_this_to_a_secure_password.
Always include .env in .gitignore immediately upon repository initialization. Never commit or push .env to version control.

protocol.name: release_and_documentation
protocol.description: Strict SemVer 2.0 and Sprint/Milestone bundled release protocol:

semver_policy.major: Breaking changes and incompatible schema/architecture updates (X.0.0)
semver_policy.minor: New functional features, modules, or exports (backwards-compatible) (1.X.0)
semver_policy.patch: Bug fixes, style/CSS fixes, minor performance improvements (1.0.X)

sprint_workflow.container: GitHub Milestones represent 2-week bundled sprint releases using convention 'Sprint JJ/WW - vX.Y.Z: Descr' (e.g. Sprint 26/41 - v1.1.0: Basisfunctionaliteit)
sprint_workflow.issue_labels: type: feature (triggers MINOR), type: bug (triggers PATCH), type: enhancement, type: documentation, type: breaking (triggers MAJOR), module:*, prio:*
sprint_workflow.cadence: Execute the full documentation and release pipeline upon milestone completion rather than per individual commit

step.action: Determine and bump SemVer version across all files based on completed milestone issues
Add bundled release section to top of CHANGELOG.md under ## [X.Y.Z] - YYYY-MM-DD and sync to docs/CHANGELOG.md

Update FAM (for UI, business process, or role changes) and TAM (for database, API, or architecture changes). On minor releases with endpoint changes, update OpenAPI 3.0 specification (docs/openapi.yaml & docs/openapi.json) and TAM API section synchronously. On every minor release, formally deliver and update the OWASP & CIS Database Security Hardening Report (docs/Database_Security_Hardening_Report.md) and the ISO/IEC 27001 Compliance Report (docs/ISO27001_Compliance_Report.md).

Run npm run build, restart background service (launchctl kickstart -k gui/$(id -u)/${DAEMON_SERVICE}), and verify with curl http://localhost:${PORT}/version.txt (HTTP 200). Fixed paths: plist at ~/Library/LaunchAgents/${DAEMON_SERVICE}.plist and logs at logs/stdout.log, logs/stderr.log
Commit all changes, tag vX.Y.Z, push to origin main, create GitHub release via gh release create, and close the GitHub Milestone
Update templates/project_kickstart_template.xml whenever generic architecture or framework improvements are introduced
